required_checks: Detailed cursor bounds and units visible in the native Simulate inspector
Light and Dark disclosure heading/readability with native fonts, pointer and keyboard expansion
Native file field Command-A and standard text editing use the first responder
Save and Cancel restore the application menu/focus; repeated dialogs and normal owned shutdown leave no temporary menu
Light/Dark outer window inset follows the root without moving content
Divider click leaves layout unchanged; off-center slow and fast drags preserve the grip
Live and recorded interval start/end refusals retain private text, show actual bounds/units and accept the first correction back to the accepted value
Interval reset works on the first click after private valid/invalid entry; an intervening agent interval survives a held button and fresh retry works
Recorded-position current refusals remain correctable; a queued pre-agent parser failure cannot install rejected text or a continuation in the newer native editor
Imported capture measurement selector defaults to the actual saved endpoint, displays 5 V constant-source mean/RMS and reports unsupported typed intervals without losing prior results
Queued pre-agent verification/time/sweep-count parser failures cannot install text in the newer form; currently owned refusals still accept a fresh correction after unrelated agent work

Captured statistics retain invalid and unsupported start/end text, distinguish cached results, recover on the first correction and discard old private/rejected entries when the measured channel changes
Captured comparison retains invalid times, distinguishes cached results, preserves independent preferences and clears old private/rejected time when the reference capture changes
Command-Z and Shift-Command-Z preserve initial text and selection in a freshly focused value field with no local history; repeated boundary Undo preserves it after a real edit
Search/value-field editing keys stay local; after leaving the editor, application Undo/Redo reaches circuit history through the native first-responder route
Wheel input over focused and unfocused number fields scrolls the enclosing pane without changing accepted values or unfinished text; explicit typing, step buttons and arrow keys remain usable
Native Verify fields accept 1 ms at 1 us, complete 1000 output intervals and reopen the capture; a duration beyond the represented bound still refuses
Wheel over focused/unfocused potentiometer slider scrolls the inspector without editing the circuit, while intentional pointer drags and arrow keys retain their shared command/history behavior
owner_authorization: Standing authorization is saved in AGENTS.md. No permission request or unattended fresh-launch prompt is queued.
unresolved_native_keyboard_observation: Native Save Command-A still fails via the tested CUA route, including direct pointer focus and 200 ms held chord. Native menu editing and Tab work; dispatch cause/hardware behavior remain unqualified.
additional_open_issue: Playback step from 0.03 through 0.031 can display 0.031999998 after Up. Accepted numerical behavior is within the existing float32 boundary; display formatting needs a focused repair that preserves tight bounds and private text.
